title: Sylvester Matrix Interpolation via Frobenius Covariants

problemStatement.plain: For a diagonalizable matrix, any (matrix) function can be written as a weighted sum of fixed "projection" matrices $Z_j$ — one per eigenvalue — weighted by the scalar values $f(\lambda_j)$. The $Z_j$ are Lagrange-interpolation polynomials in $A$ and act as projectors onto the eigenspaces. We want a formal proof of this representation.
